metadata.title: SATEX Commerce
metadata.description: Wholesale fabrics. Let AI find your fabric in seconds.

hero.title: Stop guessing.
hero.subtitle: Let AI find your <highlight>fabric</highlight> in seconds.
hero.lead: Describe your project: our AI scans over a thousand references and suggests the in-stock fabric that fits, with composition, weight, width and best use.

about.title: SATEX Commerce, your fabric partner
about.lead: Wholesale fabrics, with stock visible in real time and AI-assisted search.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: SATEX Commerce has been a textile expert since {year}. We sell fabrics wholesale to designers, workshops and manufacturers.
story.p2: Today our platform brings together AI search, real-time stock and the management of orders, deliveries and cutting jobs in one place.

fabricHalls.body: Natural fibers, knits, denim, shirting, upholstery, eveningwear: each hall shows its stock.

cutting.title: Cutting room
cutting.body: Cutting jobs are prepared and tracked through to shipping.

shipping.body: Orders are packed and delivered with tracking.

studio.body: Upstairs: the design studio, the client suite and the offices.

transparency.title: Transparency
